roost verb

also roosting, perch for the night, have its roost

classical

Varr. RR 3.3.7: aviāria, in quibus stabulentur turdī ac pāvōnēs (Lewis & Short)
Ov. Met. 13.822 (Lewis & Short)

stabulor, stabulārī, stabulātus sum

verb, first conjugation, deponent

have its abode, be housed (of animals): to stable, kennel, roost

Examples

  • aviāria, in quibus stabulentur turdī ac pāvōnēs

    aviaries for thrushes and peacocks to roost inVarr. RR 3.3.7 (Lewis & Short)
